architecture: Three full Conv128/256/128 kernels8/5/3, BN/ReLU, temporal GAP and fixed12 softmax; no shrinking.
evidence_limit: Original UCR univariate experiments do not establish cross-user UWB improvement. This is a published baseline transfer, not an original contribution.
source_distinction: Paper-linked cauchyturing author FCN.py uses univariate Conv2D and train-global z-normalization. hfawaz review fcn.py uses Conv1D over supplied multivariate channels; its mts_archive loader adds no normalization. These are separate implementations, not asserted numerically equivalent.
training: Review defaults2000epochs/B16 (min(ntrain/10,16)), unweighted CE/Adam, ReduceLR(trainingloss,.5,p50,min1e-4) then strict minimum trainingloss checkpoint. Test-label encoder in original drivers will not be executed; adaptation uses fixed12 labels and excludes7-8.
runtime_difference: Native Keras3/Torch compatibility only. Adam epsilon1e-7 differs from paper1e-8; no legacy TF parity claim.
next: One full2000/B16/seed20261029 fixed synthetic CPU policy, no sweep/fallback. Real UWB only after a separate runner/role/accuracy-gate preregistration if resources pass.
